name: realistic_eval_100_candidate
purpose: Candidate 100-question realistic-retrieval benchmark. First 10 questions are the approved pilot, copied exactly. Not frozen. Not scientifically validated. Do not run FAISS until after human review.
labeling_rule: A verse is gold only if retrieving it would reasonably count as a successful answer to the user's question. Nearby scene, background, or explanatory verses are not gold.
rules: Queries are English user-style questions, not the exact CSV en field.
primary_row_index must come from the frozen 500 pool and must be unique across the 100 questions.
relevant_row_indices is the full gold set (primary first). Extra gold only if a verse independently answers.
Do not treat this file as production retrieval input.
Do not treat automatic validation as scientific validation.

questions.question: Where did Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana settle after they continued their exile journey on foot?
questions.sn: ततस्तौ पादचारेण गच्छन्तौ सह सीतया। रम्यमासेदतुः शैलं चित्रकूटं मनोरमम् ॥
questions.en: Then they proceeding on foot along with Sītā, arrived at the charming and beautiful mountain Citrakuta.
questions.relevance_justification: 3653 names Citrakuta as the place they reached with Sita. 3654 continues that they arrived at that mountain. 3656 is Rama saying they will dwell there. 3657 (Valmiki's ashram) was removed because it answers a different location.
questions.additional_gold_justification: 3653 names Citrakuta as the place they reached with Sita. 3654 continues that they arrived at that mountain. 3656 is Rama saying they will dwell there. 3657 (Valmiki's ashram) was removed because it answers a different location.

questions.question: When Rama was leaving for exile, how long did he tell his father it would be before they saw each other again?
questions.sn: चतुर्दशसु वर्षेषु गतेषु नृपसत्तम। पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि मां प्राप्तं संतापोऽयं विमुच्यताम्॥
questions.en: O best of monarchs, after the fourteen years have been spent, you will see me again by your side, therefore do you banish this grief.
questions.relevance_justification: Only 2983 states the fourteen-year duration and the promised return. Nearby verses about going to the forest do not answer how long.

questions.question: How did the elders in the assembly react when Yudhishthira staked Draupadi in the dice game?
questions.sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ते तु वचने धर्मराजेन धीमता। धिग्धिगित्येव वृद्धानां सभ्यानां निःसृता गिरः॥
questions.en: Vaishampayana said When this was said by the wise Dharmaraja (Yudhisthira), “Fie! Fie!" were the words uttered by all the elders that were present in the assembly.
questions.relevance_justification: 28526 is the elders saying Fie. 28527 is Bhishma, Drona, and Kripa sweating while the assembly grieves. 28528 is Vidura's stunned reaction. 28525 (the stake) is background. 28530 was removed because it centers on Karna and Dushasana laughing.
questions.additional_gold_justification: 28526 is the elders saying Fie. 28527 is Bhishma, Drona, and Kripa sweating while the assembly grieves. 28528 is Vidura's stunned reaction. 28525 (the stake) is background. 28530 was removed because it centers on Karna and Dushasana laughing.

questions.question: After Arjuna broke the brothers' household rule, how long did he go to live in the forest?
questions.sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच सोऽभ्यनुज्ञाय राजानं वनचर्याय दीक्षितः। वने द्वादश वर्षाणि वासायानुजगाम ह॥
questions.en: Vaishampayana said : Having obtained the king's permission, he made preparations to live in the forest. He went away to dwell in the forest for twelve years.
questions.relevance_justification: Only 26053 states the twelve-year forest stay. Nearby verses explain the broken rule but do not answer how long.

questions.question: Where was Duryodhana hiding after the Kurukshetra battle?
questions.sn: तस्माद् गच्छामहे सर्वे यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः। आख्यातुं सलिले सुप्तं दुर्योधनममर्षणम्॥
questions.en: Let us then go all of us where king Yudhishthira is, for telling him that the vindictive Duryodhana is living hidden within the waters of this lake.
questions.relevance_justification: Replaces the ambiguous Baka/Brahmana item. 66920, 66917, and 66921 each independently say Duryodhana is hidden in the lake waters. This is a different episode from question 7 (Krishna's peace embassy).
questions.additional_gold_justification: Replaces the ambiguous Baka/Brahmana item. 66920, 66917, and 66921 each independently say Duryodhana is hidden in the lake waters. This is a different episode from question 7 (Krishna's peace embassy).

questions.question: When Draupadi was being comforted after the dice-game insult, who did her brother say would kill Drona, Bhishma, Duryodhana, and Karna?
questions.sn: धृष्टद्युम्न उवाच अहं द्रोणं हनिष्यामि शिखण्डी तु पितामहम्। दुर्योधनं भीमसेनः कर्णं हन्ताधनंजयः॥ रामकृष्णौ व्यपाश्रित्य अजेयाः स्म रणे स्वसः। अपि वृत्रहणा युद्धे किं पुनधृतराष्ट्रजे॥
questions.en: Dhristadyumna said : I shall kill Drona, Sikhandi will kill the Grandsire (Bhishma), Bhimasena will kill Duryodhana and Karna will be killed by Dhananjaya (Arjuna). O sister, with the assistance of Rama (Baladeva) and Krishna we are invincible even in a battle with the slayer of Vritra (Indra), what (to speak of a battle) with the sons of Dhritarashtra.
questions.relevance_justification: Only 29524 lists the four killer assignments. Krishna's consolation verses in the same scene do not answer this question.

questions.question: According to Vidura, why was Duryodhana unwilling to make peace when Krishna came as an envoy?
questions.sn: भीष्मे द्रोणे कृपे कर्णे द्रोणपुत्रे जयद्रथे। भूयसी वर्तते वृत्तिं न शमे कुरुते मनः॥
questions.en: He has too great a confidence on Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Karna, the son of Drona and Jayadratha and therefore he does not think of peace.
questions.relevance_justification: 44030: he trusts those warriors, so he will not consider peace. 44031: he believes the Pandavas cannot face Bhishma and Drona. 44033: he believes Karna alone can win and will not agree to peace. Each is independently a reason for refusing peace.

questions.question: In the teaching about Death, what is said to happen to people after the body is destroyed?
questions.sn: सर्वे जीवाः प्राणिनां प्राणनान्ते गत्वा वृत्ताः संनिवृत्तास्तथैव। एवं सर्वे मानवाः प्राणनान्ते गत्वा वृत्ताः देववद्राजसिंह॥
questions.en: As the senses of all creatures disappear when they are in dreamless slumber and return once more when they awake, similarly, upon the dissolution of their bodies, all human beings have to go into the other world and return thence to this, O foremost of kings.
questions.relevance_justification: 78148: after the body is destroyed, humans go to the other world and return. 78149: when bodies are destroyed, the life-wind enters new bodies. 78147 (do not grieve / diseases) does not answer what happens after death. 78150 (gods and mortals exchange states) was dropped because it does not independently address bodily destruction.
questions.additional_gold_justification: 78148: after the body is destroyed, humans go to the other world and return. 78149: when bodies are destroyed, the life-wind enters new bodies. 78147 (do not grieve / diseases) does not answer what happens after death. 78150 (gods and mortals exchange states) was dropped because it does not independently address bodily destruction.

questions.question: If a king is weaker than a neighbor, how does Bhishma say he may still attack that stronger kingdom?
questions.sn: राष्ट्रं च पीडयेत् तस्य शस्त्राग्निविषमूर्च्छनैः। अमात्यवल्लभानां च विवादास्तस्य कारयेत्॥
questions.en: He should assail the kingdom of the stronger one by neans of weapons fire, and the administering of poison. He should also create dissensions amongst his ministers and servants.
questions.relevance_justification: Only 72175 answers how: weapons, fire, poison, and sowing dissension. 72174 says a weak king should try to attack, but not how. Later verses advising conciliation answer a different question.

questions.question: When Bhishma defends giving Krishna the highest honor, what does he say about Krishna's place in the universe?
questions.sn: आदित्यश्चन्द्रमाश्चैव नक्षत्राणि ग्रहाश्च ये। दिशश्च विदिशश्चैव सर्वं कृष्णे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
questions.en: The sun, the moon, the stars, the planets, the chief directions and the intermediate directions are all established in Krishna.
questions.relevance_justification: 27829: sun, moon, stars, planets, and directions are established in Krishna. 27826: Krishna is origin and dissolution of the universe. 27828: intellect, elements, and living beings are established in Krishna. Each independently states Krishna's cosmic place. 27823 (virtues living for Krishna) was dropped because it does not answer that question.
questions.additional_gold_justification: 27829: sun, moon, stars, planets, and directions are established in Krishna. 27826: Krishna is origin and dissolution of the universe. 27828: intellect, elements, and living beings are established in Krishna. questions.question: Which rakshasi did Vishvamitra warn Rama was destroying the lands of Malada and Karusha?
questions.sn: राक्षसो भैरवाकारो नित्यं त्रासयते प्रजाः। इमौ जनपदौ नित्यं विनाशयति राघव ॥ मलदांश्च करूषांश्च ताटका दुष्टचारिणी।
questions.en: And that Rākṣasa of dreadful form daily frightens people. And, O descendant of Raghu, Tātakā of wicked deeds, daily commits havoc upon these countries, Maladã and Karuşă.
questions.relevance_justification: 640 names Tataka as the one who daily ruins Malada and Karusha.
questions.flag_notes: Question reuses the place-names Malada and Karusha from the verse; review whether that is too close to the Dutt wording.

questions.question: While Vasistha stood with the Brahmanas before Dasaratha, what immediate order did he ask the king to give concerning Rama?
questions.sn: अयं वसिष्ठो भगवान् ब्राह्मणैः सह तिष्ठति। क्षिप्रमाज्ञाप्यतां राजन् राघवस्याभिषेचनम्॥
questions.en: And the worshipful Vasiştha stays with the Brāhmaṇas. Do you, O king, immediately order the installation of Rāma.
questions.relevance_justification: 2326 is Vasistha telling the king to order Rama's installation at once.

questions.question: When Rama entered to see Dasaratha about the coronation, whom did he find sitting with his father, and how did the king look?
questions.sn: स ददर्शासने रामो विषण्णं पितरं शुभे। कैकेय्या सहितं दीनं मुखेन परिशुष्यता॥
questions.en: Rāma saw his father, seated on a beautiful sofa with Kaikeyi, looking sorry and poorly and with his countenance dried up.
questions.relevance_justification: 2410 is Rama seeing Dasaratha seated with Kaikeyi, looking wretched and dried-up.

questions.question: On the day people had dressed for Rama's installation, what did those present notice about Rama's face?
questions.sn: सर्वोऽप्यभिजनः श्रीमाञ्श्रीमतः सत्यवादिनः। नालक्षयत रामस्य कंचिदाकारमानने॥
questions.en: All persons, who were present there and who adorned themselves on account of the installation, did not perceive any sign of mental agony on the face of Rāma.
questions.relevance_justification: 2481 states that nobody saw any sign of mental agony on Rama's face.

questions.question: When Rama was getting Sita onto the river raft, what belongings did he place beside her?
questions.sn: तत्र श्रियमिवाचिन्त्यां रामो दाशरथिः प्रियाम्। ईषत्स लज्जमानां तामध्यारोपयत प्लवम्॥ पार्वे तत्र च वैदेह्या वसने भूषणानि च। प्लवे कठिनकाजंच रामश्चके समाहितः॥
questions.en: Then Dasaratha's son, Rāma, made his bashful wife (in power) inconceivable like to Śrī herself, ascend the raft, and carefully laid beside Vaidehī her attires and ornaments as well as the hoe and the basket.
questions.relevance_justification: 3628 says Rama seated Sita on the raft and laid her clothes, ornaments, hoe, and basket beside her.

questions.question: After leaving his counselors behind, whom did Bharata go to visit, following the family priest?
questions.sn: ततः संदर्शने तस्य भरद्वाजस्य राघवः। मन्त्रिणस्तानवस्थाप्य जगामानुपुरोहितम्॥
questions.en: Then with the view of seeing Bharadvāja, that descendent of Raghu leaving behind the counsellors also, went in the wake of the priest.
questions.relevance_justification: 4557 says Bharata left the ministers and went after the priest in order to see Bharadvaja.

questions.question: After Sita was abducted, at which lake did Rama begin to lament while walking with Lakshmana?
questions.sn: स तां पुष्करिणीं गत्वा पद्मोत्पलझषाकुलाम्। रामः सौमित्रिसहितो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः॥
questions.en: Repairing with Lakşmaņa to the lake Pampā filled with red and while lotuses and fish Rāma having his senses agitated began to lament.
questions.relevance_justification: 7394 names lake Pampa as the place Rama reached with Lakshmana and began to lament.

questions.question: In Sugriva's search orders, where were the monkeys told to look together for Rama's wife?
questions.sn: एतेषां गिरिदुर्गेषु प्रपातेषु वनेषु च। मार्गध्वं सहिताः सर्वे रामपत्नी यशस्विनीम्॥
questions.en: In all these mountain fastnesses, cascades and woods, do you together search for the renowned wife of Rama.
questions.relevance_justification: 8823 instructs them to search mountain fastnesses, cascades, and woods for Sita. Neighboring verses name different rivers or islands, so they are not gold for this wording.

questions.question: During the search for Sita, what does this counsel say happens to people who keep acting, compared with people who give in to grief?
questions.sn: अवश्यं कुर्वतां तस्य दृश्यते कर्मणः फलम्। परं निर्वेदमागम्य नहि नोन्मीलनं क्षमम्॥
questions.en: Those who act, for certain behold the fruit of their endeavours; but if people once give way to grief, they cannot again attain vigour.
questions.relevance_justification: 9048 contrasts acting (fruit of effort appears) with giving way to grief (vigour cannot return).

questions.question: What object, stored in its case, did Janaka's counselors bring when they approached the king?
questions.sn: तामादाय सुमञ्जूषामायसीं यत्र तद्धनुः। सुरोपमं ते जनकमूचुर्नृपतिमन्त्रिणः॥
questions.en: And having brought that bow plaited with iron, placed in its case, the royal counsellors spoke to Janaka resembling an immortal, saying,
questions.relevance_justification: 1554 says the counselors brought the iron-plated bow in its case to Janaka.

questions.question: When Sita was heard weeping in the forest, whom did the young rishis go to tell?
questions.sn: सीतां तु रुदतीं दृष्ट्वा ते तत्र मुनिदारकाः। प्राद्रवन्यत्र भगवानास्ते वाल्मीकिरुनधीः॥ अभिवाद्यः मुनेः पादौ मुनिपुत्रा महर्षये। सर्वे निवेदयामासुस्तस्यास्तु रुदितस्वनम्॥
questions.en: Beholding Sītā thus wailing, the sons of the Rşis there speedily approached the great Vālmīki, well-established in asceticism. And saluting him they all communicated to him Sītā's bewailing and said.
questions.relevance_justification: 18189 says the rishis' sons ran to Valmiki and reported Sita's wailing.

questions.question: In this teaching spoken to Rama, whose life is called happy, and whose life unhappy?
questions.sn: सुजीवं नित्यशस्तस्य यः परैरुपजीव्यते। राम तेन तु दुर्जीवं यः परानुपजीवति॥
questions.en: O Rāma, ever happy is the life of him that others depend upon for subsistence: unhappy is the life of the person that depends upon others for support.
questions.relevance_justification: 5017: happy is the person others depend on; unhappy is the person who depends on others.

questions.question: What two things did Sugriva promise Rama he would regain after seeing Rama's grief?
questions.sn: आत्मानुमानात् पश्यामि मग्नस्त्वं शोकसागरे। त्वामहं तारयिष्यामि बाढं प्राप्स्यसि पुष्कलम्॥
questions.en: By what I myself feel, I see that you had sunk in a sea of sorrow. But I will deliver you; and you shall attain both your wife as well as this kingdom.
questions.relevance_justification: 7761 is Sugriva promising to deliver Rama so that he will recover both his wife and the kingdom.

questions.question: Where did Janaka say his brother Kusadhvaja ruled, and what river washed that city?
questions.sn: भ्राता मम महातेजा वीर्यवानतिधार्मिकः। कुशध्वज इति ख्यातः पुरीमध्यवसच्छुभाम्॥ वार्याफलकपर्यन्तां पिबन्निक्षुमती नदीम्। सांकाश्यां पुण्यसंकाशां विमानमिव पुष्पकम्॥
questions.en: My highly energetic, puissant and eminently righteous brother known by the name of Kusadhvaja dwell in the auspicious city, Sāņkāśyā, whose ramparts are ranged round with pointed weapons, and which is laved by the river Ikşumatī, and which resembles the celestial regions or the aerial car, Pușpaka.
questions.relevance_justification: 1604 names Kusadhvaja's city as Sankasya, washed by the river Ikshumati.

questions.question: According to Sugriva, why was extra help unnecessary for Rama in battle?
questions.sn: धनुर्विस्फारमाणस्य यस्य शब्देन लक्ष्मण। सशैला कम्पिता भूमिः सहायैः किं नु तस्य वै॥
questions.en: O Lakşmaņa, what is the use of help to him the sounds of whose stretching bow made the Earth tremble with her mountains?
questions.relevance_justification: 8701: the mere sound of Rama stretching his bow made the earth and mountains tremble, so helpers are pointless.

questions.question: When the monkeys were discouraged at the ocean, what feat were they urging Hanuman to attempt, and to whose three strides did they compare it?
questions.sn: विषण्णा हरयः सर्वे हनुमन् किमुपेक्षसे। विक्रमस्व महावेग विष्णुस्त्रीन् विक्रमानिव ॥
questions.en: All the monkeys are depressed. O Hanuman, did you overlook this? Put forth your you endowed with mighty vehemence, like Vişnu sing over the three worlds in three steps.
questions.relevance_justification: 9401 urges Hanuman to put forth his power like Vishnu covering the three worlds in three steps.
questions.flag_notes: Question mentions Vishnu's three steps, which is also in the source English.

questions.question: After leaving the northern direction, toward which quarter did the great muni go to perform severe austerities?
questions.sn: अथ हैमवतीं राम दिशं त्यक्त्वा महामुनिः। पूर्वां दिशमनुप्राप्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्॥
questions.en: Forsaking the northern direction the mighty Muni, O Rāma, betaking himself to the Eastern quarter, became engaged in dreadful austerities.
questions.relevance_justification: 1499 says the muni left the north and undertook dreadful austerities in the east.

questions.question: How does this teaching spoken to Rama compare family, home, and property to a traveler's overnight stop?
questions.sn: यथा ग्रामान्तरं गच्छन् नरः कश्चिद् बहिर्वसेत्। उत्सृज्य च तमावासं प्रतिष्ठेतापरेऽहनि॥ एवमेव मनुष्याणां पिता माता गृहं वसु। आवासमात्रं काकुत्स्थ सज्जन्ते नात्र सज्जनाः॥
questions.en: No individual has any one (in the world). As on the eve of setting out for another country, a person stays somewhere (outside the village he lives in), and the next day goes away, renouncing that abode, even such are a man's father and mother, house and wealth. O Kākutstha, worthy people never bear affection towards a mere abode.
questions.relevance_justification: 5099 compares parents, house, and wealth to a traveler's overnight stop that is left the next day.
questions.flag_notes: Question keeps the triad parents/home/wealth and the traveler-lodging analogy, which is the verse's distinctive wording.

questions.question: Which of Shantanu and Satyavati's sons inherited the throne after the other was slain by Gandharvas before adulthood?
questions.sn: विचित्रवीर्यश्चित्राङ्गदश्च। तयोरप्राप्तयौवन एव चित्राङ्गदो गन्धर्वेण हतः; विचित्रवीर्यस्तु राजाऽऽसीत्॥
questions.en: Namely Vichitravirya and Chitrangada. But before they attained to their youth, Chitrangada was killed by the Gandharvas. Therefore, Vichitravirya became king.
questions.relevance_justification: 22706 states that Chitrangada was killed before youth and therefore Vichitravirya became king.

questions.question: How did Duryodhana propose to buy Drupada's court away from Yudhishthira's side?
questions.sn: अथवा द्रुपदो राजा महद्भिर्वित्तसंचयैः। पुत्राश्चास्य प्रलोभ्यन्ताममात्याश्चैव सर्वशः॥ परित्यजेद् यथा राजा कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। अथ तत्रैव वा तेषां निवासं रोचयन्तु ते॥ इहैषां दोषवद्वासं वर्णयन्तु पृथक् पृथक्। ते भिद्यमानास्तत्रैव मनः कुर्वन्तु पाण्डवाः॥
questions.en: Or let the king Drupada with his sons and ail his ministers of state be tempted by the presents of large wealth, so that they may abandon the cause of the son of Kunti, Yudhishthira. Or let them (our spies) speak to each of them separately the inconvenience of this place (Hastinapur) and induce them to live there (in Panchala.) Thus separated from the Kurus, they may live permanently there.
questions.relevance_justification: 25741 proposes tempting Drupada, his sons, and ministers with large gifts so they abandon Yudhishthira.
questions.flag_notes: Same Duryodhana-Vidura plotting conversation as the Dhritarashtra/Vidura-concealment question (row 25737).

questions.question: After Krishna had spoken as a friend seeking peace, what did Bhishma tell Duryodhana not to follow instead?
questions.sn: कृष्णेन वाक्यमुक्तोऽसि सुहृदां शममिच्छता। अन्वपद्यस्व तत् तात मा मन्युवशमन्वगाः॥
questions.en: “By Krishna has been spoken the words of a friend wishing for peace; listen to that my dear son, and do not follow the lead if vindictiveness.
questions.relevance_justification: 44857: Bhishma tells his son to listen to Krishna's peace-words and not follow vindictiveness.

questions.question: According to Kunti, what livelihood belongs to each of the four social orders?
questions.sn: ब्राह्मणः प्रचरेद् भैक्षं क्षत्रिय: परिपालयेत्। वैश्यो धनार्जनं कुर्याच्छूद्रः परिचरेच्च तान्॥
questions.en: A Brahmana should live on alms, a Kshatriya should protect his subjects, a Vaishya should acquire wealth and a Shudra should serve all these other orders.
questions.relevance_justification: 45154 assigns alms, protecting subjects, acquiring wealth, and serving the other orders.

questions.question: According to the snake who spoke with Bhima, what three kinds of rebirth can a person's own acts produce?
questions.sn: सर्प उवाच तिगे वै गतयो राजन् परिदृष्टाः स्वकर्मभिः। मानुषं स्वर्गवासश्च तिर्यग्योनिश्च तत् त्रिधा॥
questions.en: The Snake replied O king, on account of their own (meritorious or evil) acts men are seen to attain one of the three conditions of rebirth as men, heavenly existence or birth among the lower animals.
questions.relevance_justification: 34870 lists human birth, heavenly existence, and birth among animals as the three results of one's acts.

questions.question: In Sanatsujata's teaching, what is named as one kind of death, what as another, and what is identified with immortality?
questions.sn: रात्मावसन्नममृतं ब्रह्मचर्यम्। पितृलोके राज्यमनुशास्ति देवः शिवः शिवानामशिवोऽशिवानाम्॥
questions.en: Current opinion is that Yama is one sort of Death; the wearing out of the soul is said to be another sort; the pursuit of Brahman or selfknowledge is immortality. The god (Yama) rules the region of the Pitris, conferring blessings on the honest and curses on the dishonest.
questions.relevance_justification: 42527: Yama is one death; wearing-out of the soul another; pursuit of Brahman/self-knowledge is immortality.

questions.question: In Krishna's battlefield teaching to Arjuna, what kind of person is said to attain peace?
questions.sn: विहाय कामान् यः सर्वान् पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः। निर्ममो निरहंकारः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति॥
questions.en: The man, who moves about casting of all desires, and being freed from attachments, carvings for things, and egoism (pride), attains to peace.
questions.relevance_justification: 48051: the person who casts off desires and is free from attachment, craving, and egoism attains peace.
questions.flag_notes: Related Gita cluster with the egoism/killing teaching (row 48559).

questions.question: When the Pandavas consulted after the ninth day's fight, what did they recall Bhishma had promised about counsel versus fighting?
questions.sn: समयस्तु कृतः कश्चिन्नमम भीष्मेण संयुगे। मन्त्रयिष्ये तवार्थाय न तु योत्स्ये कथञ्चन॥
questions.en: Before this battle there was an understanding between me and Bhishma. He said 'I will give you good counsel, but will not fight for your interests.
questions.relevance_justification: 51530 is Bhishma's prior pledge: he will give counsel but will not fight for the Pandavas' interests.
questions.additional_gold_justification: 51531 continues the same pledge independently: Bhishma will fight for Duryodhana's interests. Together they answer what he would and would not do.
questions.flag_notes: 51531 is a continuation of the same quoted pledge. Review whether it independently answers or is only the next clause.

questions.question: After Bhishma had spoken to Duryodhana from the bed of arrows, what did he then do despite his wounds?
questions.sn: एतद् वाक्यं सौहृदादापगेयो मध्ये राज्ञां भारतं श्रावयित्वा। तूष्णीमासीच्छल्यसंतप्तमर्मा योज्यात्मानं वेदनां संनियम्य॥
questions.en: Having out of affection spoken these words of Duryodhana among all those kings, the son of Ganga remained silent; though his vital parts were then being consumed by those arrowwounds, he, overcoming his agony, kept himself tranquil.
questions.relevance_justification: 52268: after speaking, Ganga's son remained silent and kept himself tranquil though his vitals were burning with arrows.

questions.question: After Bhishma, Drona, Karna, Jayadratha, Duryodhana's brothers, and Lakshmana had fallen, what question did Kripa raise about continuing?
questions.sn: तदत्र प्रतिवक्ष्यामि किंचिदेव हितं वचः। हते भीष्मे च द्रोणे च कर्णे चैव महारथे॥ जयद्रथे च निहते तव भ्रातृषु चनाघ! लक्ष्मणे तव पुत्रे च किं शेषं पर्युपासते॥
questions.en: I will say a few wholesome words to you about this. After the fall of Bhishma and Drona and the mighty car-warrior Karna, after the slaughter of Jayadratlia and your brothers, O sinless one and your son Lakshmana, what is there now for us to do?
questions.relevance_justification: 65605 lists those deaths and asks what remains for them to do now.

questions.question: When Yudhishthira was leaving for the forest after the dice game, which elders did he formally bid farewell to first?
questions.sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आमन्त्रयामि भरतांस्तथा वृद्धं पितामहम्। राजानं सोमदत्तं च महाराजं च बाह्निकम्॥
questions.en: Yudhisthira said I bid farewell to all the descendants of Bharata, to my old grandsire (Bhisma) to king Somadatta, the great king Valhika.
questions.relevance_justification: 28889: he takes leave of the Bharatas, aged grandsire Bhishma, Somadatta, and king Vahlika.

questions.question: What long-sought purpose did Kirmira say had brought him roaming armed across the world?
questions.sn: विदुर उवाच किर्मीरस्तवब्रवीदेनं दिष्ट्या देवैरिदं मम। उपपादितमोह चिरकालान्मनोगतम्॥ भीमसेनवधार्थं हि नित्यमभ्युद्यतायुधः। चराम पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां नैनं चासादयाम्यहम्॥
questions.en: Vidura said: Kirmira replied, “By good luck, Fate has accomplished today my long cherished desire. With weapons upraised, I have been continually wandering over the earth with the object of killing Bhima. But I did not find him.
questions.relevance_justification: 29369: Kirmira says he had long been roaming in order to kill Bhima and had not found him.

questions.question: During the fight at Saubha, what did Krishna say he started doing with his arrows to the enemies of the gods?
questions.sn: वासुदेव उवाच ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रगृह्य रुचिरंधनुः। शरैरपातयं सौभाच्छिरांसि विबुधद्विषाम्॥
questions.en: Krishna said : O best of the Bharata race, then taking up my beautiful bow, I began to cut off with my arrows the heads of the enemies of the celestials from the (car) Saubha.
questions.relevance_justification: 29736: Krishna took his bow and began cutting off their heads from the Saubha car.
questions.flag_notes: Same Saubha episode as the question about where Shalva stood (row 29690).

questions.question: What gift from Airavata's pair of bells did Indra present to Skanda?
questions.sn: ऐरावतस्य घण्टे द्वे वैजयन्त्याविति श्रुते। गुहस्य ते स्वयं दत्ते क्रमेणानाय्य धीमता॥
questions.en: Airavata had two Bells named Vaijayanti. The intelligent Indra brought them and personally gave them to Guha.
questions.relevance_justification: 36581: Indra brought Airavata's two Vaijayanti bells and gave them to Guha.

questions.question: When Kunti invoked Surya, what did she keep gazing at without growing tired of its beauty?
questions.sn: तत्र बद्धमनोदृष्टिरभवत् सा सुमध्यमा। न चातप्यत रूपेण भानोः संध्यागतस्य सा॥
questions.en: And both the mind and the eye of that slender-waisted girl were steadfastly fixed on the solar orb. She did not feel satiety at beholding the beauty of the morning sun.
questions.relevance_justification: 38758: her mind and eyes stayed fixed on the morning sun and she felt no satiety.

questions.question: In Virata's court, what physical insult did Draupadi say the suta's son had given her?
questions.sn: ये दधुर्न च याचेयुर्ब्रह्मण्याः सत्यवादिनः। तेषां मां मानिनी भार्यां सूतपुत्रः पदावधीत्॥
questions.en: The son of a Suta has kicked me, the respected consort of those who are truthful, devoted to Brahmans and used to give away without asking any thing in gift.
questions.relevance_justification: 39535: Draupadi says the suta's son kicked her.

questions.question: Where in Virata's palace did Draupadi find Bhima waiting?
questions.sn: ततो महानसद्वारि भीमसेनमवस्थितम्। ददर्श राजन् पाञ्चाली यथा मत्तं महाद्विपम्॥
questions.en: Then, o king, Panchali saw Bhimsena, waiting at the kitchen door like a huge infuriated elephant.
questions.relevance_justification: 39839: she saw Bhima standing at the kitchen door.

questions.question: Just before Kurukshetra, why did the earth become crowded with kings?
questions.sn: समाकुला मही राजन् कुरुपाण्डवकारणात्। तदा समभवत् कृत्स्ना सम्प्रयाणे महीक्षिताम्॥
questions.en: At that time, o king the earth became crowded with the throng of kings who had come either for the Kauravas or for the Pandavas.
questions.relevance_justification: 41154: kings had gathered either for the Kauravas or for the Pandavas.

questions.question: Instead of fighting, what did Krishna propose the visiting kings do together before returning to their own countries?
questions.sn: शिवेनेमे भूमिपाला: समागम्य परस्परम्। सह भुक्त्वा च पीत्वा च प्रतियान्तु यथागृहम्॥
questions.en: These protectors of the earth meeting one another in a spirit of peace and having dined and drank together, let them return to their respective homes.
questions.relevance_justification: 44152: dine and drink together, then return to their own homes.

questions.question: What amazed Dhritarashtra about his own heart after he heard that Bhishma had been slain?
questions.sn: यच्छ्रुत्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रं हतं भीष्मं न दीर्यते। यस्मिन्नस्त्राणि मेधा च नीतिश्च पुरुषर्षभे॥
questions.en: For it does not burst even on hearing the death of Bhishma that foremost of all men, in whom were intelligence and policy and skill in arms.
questions.relevance_justification: 47715: he notes that his heart does not burst even on hearing Bhishma's death.

questions.question: On that morning of battle, which Kaurava leaders did Shikhandin attack with Virata, and which leaders did Arjuna attack?
questions.sn: संजय उवाच शिखण्डी सह मत्स्येन विराटेन विशाम्पते। भीष्ममाशु महेष्वासमाससाद सुदुर्जयम्॥ द्रोणं कृपं विकर्णं च महेष्वासं महाबलम्। राज्ञश्चान्यान् रणे शूरान् बहूना द् धनंजयः॥
questions.en: Sanjaya said O ruler of men, Shikhandin, with the king of the Matsyas viz., Virata, speedily rushed against Bhishma, that mighty bowman difficult of being defeated in battle. Dhananjaya in that battle rushed against Drona, Kripa, Vikarna, and many kings, all mighty-bowmen, brave,, and endued with great prowess.
questions.relevance_justification: 49930: Shikhandin with Virata attacked Bhishma; Arjuna attacked Drona, Kripa, Vikarna, and other kings.
questions.flag_notes: Battle-cluster overlap with other Kurukshetra action questions.

questions.question: After Arjuna slew Bhagadatta, what did he then do to the rest of the Kaurava warriors?
questions.sn: निहत्य तं नरपतिमिन्द्रविक्रम सखायमिन्द्रस्य तदैन्द्रिराहवे। ततोऽपरांस्तव जयकाक्षिणो नरान् बभञ्ज वायुर्बलवान् द्रमानिव॥
questions.en: Then in that battle, the son of Indra having slain that monarch equal to Indra in prowess and who was a friend of Indra, began to crush, inspired with the hopes of victory, other warriors of your army, like a violent gust of wind crushing large number to trees.
questions.relevance_justification: 53471: after slaying that king, Arjuna began crushing the remaining warriors like a gale crushing trees.

questions.question: After Arjuna challenged Ashvatthaman, what did Krishna do with Arjuna?
questions.sn: एवमुक्तोऽवहत् पार्थं कृष्णो द्रोणात्मजान्तिके। जैत्रेण विधिनाऽऽहूतं वायुरिन्द्रमिवाध्वरे॥
questions.en: Having been thus addressed (by Arjuna), Krishna carried, to the near presence of the son of Drona, the son of Pritha, who was invited to battle according to the prescribed maxims of triumphant challenge; even as the God of wind carries Indra to the sacrificial place.
questions.relevance_justification: 61605: Krishna drove Arjuna to Drona's son's presence, as wind carries Indra to a sacrifice.

questions.question: After Duryodhana had fallen, what mistake did the speaker say Yudhishthira had made about deciding the war?
questions.sn: तदेवं विजयः प्राप्तः पुनः संशयितः कृतः। अबुद्धिरेषा महती धर्मराजस्य पाण्डव॥ यदेकविजये युद्धं पाणितं घोरमीद्दशम्। सुयोधनः कृती वीर एकायनगतस्तथा॥
questions.en: Having thus gained the victory, he pleased himself once more in a doubtful and perilous situation. This has been great mistake on the part of Yudhishthira, O Pandava, since he has made the result of the battle depend upon the victory or the defeat of only one warrior! Suyodhana is an expert, he is a hero; he is of firm determination.
questions.relevance_justification: 68145: Yudhishthira made the whole result depend on the victory or defeat of only one warrior.

questions.question: Why was Dhritarashtra told not to grieve for the slain Kuru heroes?
questions.sn: अवश्यं भवितव्ये च कुरूणां वैशसे नृप। कस्माच्छोचसि ताशूरान् गतान् परमिकां गतिम्।।
questions.en: This destruction of the Kurus, O king, was inevitable. Why then do you grieve for those heroes that have achieved the highest end?
questions.relevance_justification: 69345: their destruction was inevitable, and those heroes had already attained the highest end.
questions.flag_notes: Related 'why grieve' cluster with Arjuna's later speeches to Yudhishthira (rows 70460, 70066).

questions.question: After Yudhishthira had won the kingdom by Kshatriya duty, why did Arjuna ask him not to keep grieving?
questions.sn: क्षत्रधर्मेण धर्मज्ञ प्राप्य राज्यं सुदुर्लभम्। जित्वा चारीन् नरश्रेष्ठ तप्यते किं भृशं भवान्॥
questions.en: 'O you who are conversant with every kind of duty, having by the practise of Kshatriya duties acquired sovereignty that is so very difficult of acquisition, and having defeated all your foes, why do you grieve.
questions.relevance_justification: 70460: he has acquired hard-won sovereignty and defeated his foes, so grief is out of place.
questions.flag_notes: Same Rajadharmanushasana consolation cluster as row 70066.

questions.question: According to this teaching on enmity, why is it unsafe to rely on an old enemy's friendly words?
questions.sn: पूजन्युवाच नास्ति वैरमतिक्रान्तं सान्त्वितोऽस्मीति नाश्वसेत्। विश्वासाद् वसते लोके तस्माच्छ्रेयोऽप्यदर्शनम्॥
questions.en: Enmity originating from mutual injuries can never die. The person injured should never trust his enemies, drinking-O I have been comforted with assurances of good will!-In this world, men frequently suffer destruction for (misplaced) confidence. Therefore, it is necessary that we should no longer meet each other.
questions.relevance_justification: 74469: enmity from mutual injury never dies; people perish from misplaced confidence, so they should not meet again.

questions.question: According to this teaching, why do ascetics regarded as wise refuse meat as food?
questions.sn: न भक्षयन्त्यतो मांसं तपोयुक्ता मनीषिणः। दोषांस्तु भक्षणे राजन् मांसस्येह निबोध मे॥
questions.en: It is therefore, that wise men who are gifted with penances refrain from eating meat. Listen to me, O king, as tell you what the faults are which attach to the eating of meat.
questions.relevance_justification: 87154 says they refrain because of the faults attached to eating meat, which the speaker then offers to explain.
questions.flag_notes: The verse announces the faults but does not list them. Review whether announcing the reason to refrain is enough of an answer.

questions.question: In this enumeration of foremost beings, who rules the waters, the storm-gods, hot bodies, and luminous bodies?
questions.sn: अम्भसां वरुणो राजा मरुतामिन्द्र उच्यते॥ अर्कोऽधिपतिरुष्णानां ज्योतिषामिन्दुरुच्यते।
questions.en: Varuna is the king of the waters. Indra is said to be the king of the Maruts. Arka is the king of all hot bodies, and Indra of all luminous bodies.
questions.relevance_justification: 89988: Varuna of waters, Indra of Maruts, Arka of hot bodies, Indra of luminous bodies.
questions.flag_notes: Indra appears twice (Maruts and luminous bodies). Review whether the last item is Indra or Indu/moon; Dutt prints 'Indra of all luminous bodies' while the Sanskrit has indu.

questions.question: After Vyasa spoke to him, what did Dhritarashtra tell Yudhishthira about his own grief?
questions.sn: इत्युक्तः कौरवो राजा व्यासेनातुलतेजसा। युधिष्ठिरमथाहूय वाग्मी वचनमब्रवीत्॥ अजातशत्रो भद्रं ते शृणु मे भ्रातृभिः सह। त्वत्प्रसादान्महीपाल शोको नास्मान् प्रबाधते॥
questions.en: Thus addressed by Vyasa of incomparable energy, the Kuru king, well versed in words summoned Yudhishthira and said to him, 'O you having no enemies, blessing on you! Do you listen to me, with all your brothers! Through your grace, O king, grief no longer stands in my way.
questions.relevance_justification: 92302: Dhritarashtra says that through Yudhishthira's grace, grief no longer stands in his way.

questions.question: When Vyasa arrived at the snake sacrifice, what kind of seat did the king offer him?
questions.sn: काञ्चनं विष्टरं तस्मै सदस्यानुमतः प्रभुः। आसनं कल्पयामास तथा शक्रो बृहस्पतेः॥
questions.en: The king, with the approval of the Sadasyas, offered a golden seat to the Rishi as did Indra to (his preceptor) Brihaspati.
questions.relevance_justification: 21361: with the sadasyas' approval, the king offered the rishi a golden seat, as Indra did for Brihaspati.

questions.question: In the Shishupala episode, how did some of the assembled warriors describe Bhishma after he had spoken?
questions.sn: केचिदूचुर्महेष्वासाः श्रुत्वा भीष्मस्य तद् वचः। पापोऽवलिप्तो वृद्धश्च नायं भीष्मोऽर्हति क्षमाम्॥
questions.en: Having heard these words of Bhishma, some of these great bowmen said, “This sinful wretch, Bhishma, though old, is exceedingly boastful. He deserves no pardon.
questions.relevance_justification: 27978: some called Bhishma a sinful, boastful old man who deserved no pardon.

questions.question: After the dice-game injuries, why did the speaker say the Pandavas would not forgive the Kauravas?
questions.sn: न क्षस्यन्ते तथास्माभिर्जातु विप्रकृता हि ते। द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेशं कस्तेषां क्षन्तुमर्हति॥
questions.en: Persecuted (as) they are (by us), they cannot forgive us for those injuries. Who is there amongst them who will be able to forgive the insult to Draupadi?
questions.relevance_justification: 28801: the persecuted Pandavas will not forgive those injuries, and none of them can forgive the insult to Draupadi.
questions.flag_notes: Dice-game aftermath cluster with the elders' 'Fie' reaction (pilot_03) and Dhrishtadyumna's killer list (pilot_06). Different questions, same broader episode.

questions.question: If Nala did not want to play dice, what alternative contest did Pushkara propose to settle their quarrel?
questions.sn: न चेद् वाञ्छसि त्वं युद्धद्यूतं प्रवर्तताम्। द्वैरथेनास्तु वै शान्तिस्तव वा मम वा नृप॥
questions.en: If you do not like the game at dice, do you then engage yourself in the play at weapons. Really, O king, let us have peace by fighting out a duel.
questions.relevance_justification: 31560 proposes a duel with weapons instead of dice so that peace would come by single combat.

questions.question: In this description, to which two Vrishni heroes is Arjuna said to be equal?
questions.sn: संकर्षणं महावीर्यं त्वां च भीमापराजितम्। अनुयातः स्ववीर्येण वासुदेवं च शत्रुहा।॥
questions.en: That chastiser of foes (Arjuna) is equal to the invincible and most powerful Sankarsana (Baladeva) and Vasudeva (Krishna).
questions.relevance_justification: 33490 equates Arjuna with invincible Sankarshana (Balarama) and Vasudeva (Krishna).

questions.question: Besides restoring Indradyumna to heaven, whom did Markandeya say Krishna had rescued from hell?
questions.sn: पाण्डवाश्चोचुः साधु शोभनं भवता कृतं राजानमिन्द्रद्युम्नं स्वर्गलोकाच्च्युतं स्वे स्थाने प्रतिपादयतेत्यथैतानब्रवीदसौ ननु देवकीपुत्रेणापि कृष्णेन कृष्णेन नरके मज्जामानो राजर्षिर्तृगस्तस्मात् कृच्छ्रात् पुनः समुद्धृत्य स्वर्ग प्रापित इति॥
questions.en: The Pandavas said : O blessed one, you acted properly in causing king Indradhyumna who had fallen from heaven to regain it. He (Markandeya) said, “The son of Devaki Krishna also had thus rescued the royal sage Nriga who had fallen into hell. He caused him to regain heaven.
questions.relevance_justification: 35635: Krishna rescued the royal sage Nriga from hell and caused him to regain heaven.

questions.question: Whom did Brihadashva install on the throne when the time came?
questions.sn: समये तं पिता राज्ये बृहदश्वोऽभ्यषेचयत्। कुवलाश्वं महाराज शूरमुत्तमधार्मिकम्॥
questions.en: O great king, in due time his father Brihadashva installed that foremost of heroes and virtuous men, Kuvalashva, on the throne.
questions.relevance_justification: 35783: Brihadashva installed his son Kuvalashva as king.

questions.question: After Dharma spoke at the lake, what happened to him, and what happened to the Pandava brothers?
questions.sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे धर्मो भगवाँल्लोकभावनः। समेताः पाण्डवाश्चैव सुखसुप्ता मनस्विनः॥
questions.en: Vaishampayana said: Saying this, the adorable Dharma, whom all the worlds pay homage to, disappeared. And the magnanimous sons of Pandu were joined together after they had enjoyed and agreeable sleep.
questions.relevance_justification: 39106: Dharma disappeared, and the Pandavas were reunited after an agreeable sleep.

questions.question: In the story of Indra's defeat, whom was the lady told to choose as husband instead of Indra, and why?
questions.sn: इन्द्रादं विशिष्टो नहुषो देवराजो महाद्युतिः। वृणोत्विमं वरारोहा भर्तृत्वे वरवर्णिनी॥
questions.en: The king of the gods Nahusha of great luster is superior to Indra. Let this lady with slender waist and bright complexion, choose him as her husband.
questions.relevance_justification: 41391: Nahusha, king of the gods, is said to be superior to Indra, so she should choose him.

questions.question: What spiritual result is promised to people who tell Vyasa's history to others, or who listen to it?
questions.sn: श्रावयिष्यन्ति ये विप्रा ये च श्रोष्यन्ति मानवाः। सर्वथा वर्तमाना वै न ते शोच्याः कृताकृतैः॥
questions.en: The Brahmanas who recite it for others to hear it and those who hear it, in whatever state duties, they may be, can never be affected by the fruits of good or bad deeds.
questions.relevance_justification: 21457: reciters and hearers cannot be affected by the fruits of good or bad deeds.
questions.flag_notes: Meta-textual claim about the Mahabharata itself rather than a story event. Review whether this is an appropriate realistic user question.

questions.question: With which companions did Balarama enter the Pandava camp?
questions.sn: प्राविशद् भवनं राजन् पाण्डवानां हलायुधः। सहाक्रूरप्रभृतिभिर्गदसाम्बोद्धवादिभिः॥
questions.en: The one, who had the slough for his। weapon (elder brother of Krishna), entered the encampment of the Pandavas, o king, in company with Akrura, Akrura, Gadha, Samba, Uddahava,
questions.relevance_justification: 45975: Halayudha entered the Pandava camp with Akrura, Gada, Samba, Uddhava, and others.

questions.question: According to this Gita teaching, what is said of a person without egoism whose mind is unsullied, even if he kills many people?
questions.sn: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते। हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते॥
questions.en: He who has no egoism, and whose mind is not sullied, does not kill, or fettered by action, if he kills all these people.
questions.relevance_justification: 48559: such a person does not kill and is not bound by action, even if he kills all these people.
questions.flag_notes: Related Gita cluster with the peace-through-renouncing-desire teaching (row 48051).

questions.question: According to Sanjaya, what was Bhishma trying to protect by fighting so hard that morning?
questions.sn: संजय उवाच अकरोत् तुमुलं युद्धं भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तदा। भीमसेनभयादिच्छन् पुत्रांस्तारयितुं तव॥ पूर्वाह्ने तन्महारौद्रं राज्ञां युद्धमवर्तत। कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च मुख्यशूरविनाशनम्॥
questions.en: Sanjaya said Then Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, fought a fierce battle, desirous of saving your sons from their fear of Bhimasena. In that morning, a most dreadful battle was fought between the kings of the Kaurava and the Pandava hosts, in which many best warriors were slain.
questions.relevance_justification: 49872: Bhishma fought in order to save Dhritarashtra's sons from their fear of Bhimasena.
questions.flag_notes: Kurukshetra battle cluster with other Bhishma-fight questions.

questions.question: What reminder is given here about Karna's earlier defeat, along with the Kaurava army, during the year the Pandavas spent in disguise?
questions.sn: विराटनगरे चापि समेताः सर्वकौरवाः। पार्थेन निर्जिता युद्धे त्वं च कर्ण सहानुजः॥
questions.en: Again, in the city of Virata, all the assembled Kauravas as well as you, O Karna, together with your younger brother were (all) defeated by Part. a in battle.
questions.relevance_justification: 58601: Partha defeated all the assembled Kauravas, including Karna and his younger brother.

questions.question: At the trial of arms, how did the spectators react to Duryodhana's speech, and what happened in the sky afterward?
questions.sn: ततः सर्वस्य रङ्गस्य हाहाकारो महानभूत्। साधुवादानुसम्बद्धः सूर्यश्चास्तमुपागमत्॥
questions.en: Thereupon there arose a loud cheer among all the spectators, approving of Duryodhana's speech. At this time the sun went down.
questions.relevance_justification: 24006: a loud approving cheer arose, and at that time the sun went down.
questions.flag_notes: Thin unique fact (cheers plus sunset). Review whether this is too weak for the benchmark.

questions.question: How did Jarasandha say he was willing to fight Krishna, Bhima, and Arjuna?
questions.sn: सैन्यं सैन्येन व्यूढेन एक एकेन वा पुनः। द्वाभ्यां त्रिभिर्वा योत्स्येऽहं युगपत् पृथगेव वा॥
questions.en: I am ready to fight with troops against troops placed in a battle array, or alone against (you) one, two or three, either at the sometime or separately.
questions.relevance_justification: 27366: army against army, or one against one, two, or three, together or separately.

questions.question: What did Abhimanyu do when he saw Dhrishtadyumna engaged with Ashvatthaman?
questions.sn: धृष्टद्युम्नं तु संयुक्तं द्रौणिना वीक्ष्य भारत। सौभद्रोऽभ्यपतत् तूर्णं विकिरन् निशिताशरान्॥
questions.en: O descendant of Bharata, seeing Dhrishtadyumna fighting with Drona's son, the son of Subhadra (Abhimanyu) ran up showering his fearful arrows.
questions.relevance_justification: 49255: Subhadra's son ran up, showering sharp arrows.
questions.flag_notes: Generic battle-action verse; review distinctiveness.

questions.question: What sounds from Drona's pavilion did Dhritarashtra say he used to hear constantly but could no longer hear?
questions.sn: सौमदत्तिं श्रुतनिधि तेषां न श्रूयते ध्वनिः। ज्याघोषो ब्रह्मघोषश्च तोमरासिरथध्वनिः॥
questions.en: The twang of bows, the sound of Vedic recitations, the whistle of shafts, the whiz of swords and the rattle of cars, these sounds were the be heard incessantly in the pavilion of Drona. But I do not hear them now.
questions.relevance_justification: 55011 lists bow-twang, Vedic recitation, shafts, swords, and chariot-rattle as sounds of Drona's pavilion that are now gone.
questions.flag_notes: English is garbled ('were the be heard'). Neighboring verses also say other camps' sounds are gone; gold is limited to Drona's pavilion only.

questions.question: When Arjuna saw the Samsaptakas formed against him, how did he respond?
questions.sn: अथ व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु प्रेक्ष्य संशप्तकान् रणे॥ क्रुद्धोऽर्जुनोऽभिदुद्राव व्याक्षिपन् गाण्डिवं धनुः।
questions.en: Beholding he Samsaptakas in battle array, Arjuna, worked up with anger, rushed against them, drawing his Gandiva bow.
questions.relevance_justification: 63015: angry Arjuna rushed at them, drawing Gandiva.
questions.flag_notes: Generic battle-action verse.

questions.question: After Yudhishthira killed Shalya, to what old victory was the army's praise of him compared?
questions.sn: युधिष्ठिरं च प्रशशंसुराजौ पुरा कृते वृत्रवधे यथेन्द्रम्। चक्रुश्च नानाविधवाद्यशब्दान् निनादयन्तो वसुधा समेताः॥
questions.en: And all of them praised Yudhishthira in that battle, even as the celestials, in days of yore, had praised Indra after the destruction of Vritra. And they beat and blew various kinds of musical instruments, making the Earth resound on all sides.
questions.relevance_justification: 66277: they praised him as the gods once praised Indra after the destruction of Vritra.

questions.question: Who did Yudhishthira say could endure the Brahmastras of Drona and Karna, when even Indra could not?
questions.sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रमुक्तं द्रोणकर्णाभ्यां ब्रह्मास्त्रमरिमर्दन॥ कस्त्वदन्यः सहेत् साक्षादपि वज्री पुरंदरः।
questions.en: Yudhishthira said Who else, except you. O destroyer of foes, not even thunder-holding Purandara himself, could have withstood the Brahma weapons discharged by Drona and Karna!
questions.relevance_justification: 68327: no one else, not even thunder-wielding Purandara (Indra), except Krishna.

questions.question: After conquering the earth, what did Arjuna say it was foolish for a royal-born king like Yudhishthira to do?
questions.sn: अस्मिन् राजकुले जातो जित्वा कृत्स्नां वसुंधराम्। धर्मार्थावखिलौ हित्वा वनं मौढ्यात् प्रतिष्ठसे॥
questions.en: You are born in a royal family. Having conquered the whole Earth, do you foolishly wish to live in the forest after for-saking everything of virtue of profit?
questions.relevance_justification: 70066: abandoning virtue and profit to go live in the forest.
questions.flag_notes: Same consolation cluster as row 70460 (Arjuna urging Yudhishthira not to renounce the kingdom).

questions.question: Which members of the Pandava household did not know about Bhima's harsh treatment of Dhritarashtra in the palace?
questions.sn: नान्वबुध्यत तद् राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ श्वेताश्वो वाथ कुन्ती वा द्रौपदी वा यशस्विनी। माद्रीपुत्रौ च धर्मज्ञौ चित्तं तस्यान्ववर्तताम्॥
questions.en: King Yudhishthira thc son of Kunti, however, knew it not; nor Arjuna of white horses; nor Kunti; nor Draupadi possessed of great fame; nor the twin sons of Madri, knowing every duty and who were always engaged in acting after the wishes of Dhritarashtra. was to
questions.relevance_justification: 91520: Yudhishthira, Arjuna, Kunti, Draupadi, and the twins did not know it.
questions.flag_notes: Source English is truncated ('was to'). The referent of 'it' depends on neighboring verses about Bhima's verbal cruelty.

questions.question: Why, in Dhritarashtra's lament, would a man who had already reached heaven in his own body come back to earth?
questions.sn: स्वर्गं हि गत्वा सशरीर एव को मानुषः पुनरागन्तुमिच्छेत्। अन्यत्र कालोपहताननेकान् समीक्षमाणस्तु कुरून् मुमूर्षुन्॥
questions.en: What man is there who having gone to heaven in his own human body ever wishes to come back? Because he sees the Kurus at the point of death by Time, he has returned.
questions.relevance_justification: 36753: a man who has gone to heaven in his own body would not wish to return unless he saw the Kurus at the point of death by Time.
questions.flag_notes: The verse never names the returned man. Neighbor 36752 identifies him as Arjuna. Review whether leaving him unnamed makes the gold too hard, or whether naming Arjuna would over-specify.

questions.question: What three hardships did Baka say even the deathless still have to endure?
questions.sn: बक उवाच अप्रियैः सह संवासः प्रियैश्चापि विनाभवः। असद्भिः सम्प्रयोगाश्च तद् दुःखं चिरजीविनाम्॥
questions.en: Baka said : To live with persons who are disagreeable, to be separated with persons that are agreeable and beloved, to associate with the wicked, these are the evils which they that are immortal have to bear.
questions.relevance_justification: 35523: living with the disagreeable, separation from the beloved, and association with the wicked.

questions.question: What did Sharmishtha ask king Yayati to do so that she could become a mother?
questions.sn: शर्मिष्ठोवाच अधर्मात् पाहि मां राजन् धर्मं च प्रतिपादय। त्वत्तोऽपत्यवती लोके चरेयं धर्ममुत्तमम्॥
questions.en: Sharmishtha said : O king, save me from sin. Protect my virtue. Becoming a mother by you, let me perform the greatest pious act in the world.
questions.relevance_justification: 22368: save her from sin, protect her virtue, and make her a mother by him.

questions.question: According to this account of Duryodhana as a portion of Kali, what role did he play in starting the great destruction?
questions.sn: उद्दीपितं येन वैरं भूतान्तकरणं महत्। पौलस्त्या भ्रातरश्चास्य जज्ञिरे मनुजेष्विह॥
questions.en: It was he who fanned the fire of hostility, the great fire of destruction. The sons of Pulastya became on earth the brothers of Duryodhana.
questions.relevance_justification: 21820: he fanned the fire of hostility, the great fire of destruction.
questions.additional_gold_justification: 21819 independently says he was the cause of the slaughter of all creatures and ruined the earth.
questions.flag_notes: Uses neighboring 21818 for the Kali identification in the question wording. Review whether that extra context is fair.

questions.question: After Rahu's head was cut off, what enmity began, and what does that head still do to the sun and moon?
questions.sn: ततो वैरविनिर्बन्धः कृतो राहुमुखेन वै। शाश्वतश्चन्द्रसूर्याभ्यां ग्रसत्यद्यापि चैव तौ॥
questions.en: From that day a great enmity was created between the head of Rahu and Chandra and Surya. To this day it swallows Chandra and Surya (causing eclipses.)
questions.relevance_justification: 20403: lasting enmity with Chandra and Surya; the head still swallows them, causing eclipses.

questions.question: What fate did Kashyapa say was coming that very day for king Parikshit?
questions.sn: काश्यप उवाच नृपं कुरुकुलोत्पन्न परिक्षितमरिन्दमम्। तक्षकः पन्नगश्रेष्ठस्तेजसाऽद्य प्रधक्ष्यति॥
questions.en: Kashyapa said: The best of snakes, Takshaka, will to-day burn the chastiser of his enemies, king Parikshit of the Kuru race;
questions.relevance_justification: 20954: Takshaka will today burn Parikshit of the Kuru race.

questions.question: Where was this cosmic being said to have been born, and for what purpose in the world?
questions.sn: पुरुषः स विभुः कर्ता सर्वभूतपितामहः। धर्मसंवर्धनार्थाय प्रजज्ञेऽन्धकवृष्णिषु॥
questions.en: This great being, possessed of infinite wealth, this Grandsire of all creatures, took his birth in the race of Andhaka Vrishnis, in order to increase the piety in the world.
questions.relevance_justification: 21560: he was born in the Andhaka-Vrishni race to increase piety.
questions.flag_notes: The verse does not name Krishna in this row; the identification is from context. Review whether the question should name Krishna or leave it as 'this great being'.

questions.question: What future was predicted for the son Shakuntala would bear to Dushyanta?
questions.sn: धर्मात्मा च महात्मा च दुष्यन्तः पुरुषोत्तमः। अभ्यगच्छः पतिं यत् त्वं भजमानं शकुन्तले॥ महात्मा जनिता लोके पुत्रस्तव महाबलः। य इमां सागरापाङ्गीं कृत्स्नां भोक्ष्यति मेदिनीम्॥
questions.en: The best of men Dushyanta, is virtuousminded and high-souled. O Shakuntala, you have accepted (this Dushyanta) for your husband. The son, whom you will give birth to, will be mighty and illustrious in this world. He will extend his sway over the whole of this earth bounded by the sea.
questions.relevance_justification: 22009: the son will be mighty and will rule the whole earth bounded by the sea.

questions.question: What did Bhima promise Hidimba's sister he would do to the rakshasa while she watched?
questions.sn: भीम उवाच मा भैस्त्वं पृथुसुश्रोणि नैष कश्चिन्मयि स्थिते। अहमेनं हनिष्यामि प्रेक्षन्त्यास्ते सुमध्यमे॥
questions.en: Bhima said: O lady of fair hips, fear nothing. I am certain that so long I am here, there is no Rakshasa who can harm any of these (men). O lady of slender waist, I shall kill this (cannibal) before your very sight.
questions.relevance_justification: 24436: he tells her not to fear and promises to kill the cannibal before her eyes.

questions.question: What did Dhritarashtra tell Duryodhana about revealing his thoughts to Vidura?
questions.sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अहमप्येवमेवैतच्चिकीर्षामि यथा युवाम्। विवेक्तुं नाहमिच्छामि त्वाकारं विदुरं प्रति॥
questions.en: Dhritarashtra said : I desire to act exactly as you desire, but I do not wish to show my mental thoughts to Vidura even by my demeanour.
questions.relevance_justification: 25737: he wants to act as they wish but does not want to show his thoughts to Vidura even by his demeanor.
questions.flag_notes: Same plotting conversation as the Drupada-bribe question (row 25741).

questions.question: In the Naga house, what rite did Arjuna perform at the fire, and how did Agni respond?
questions.sn: ददर्श पाण्डवस्तत्र पावकं सुसमाहितः। कौरव्यस्याथ नागस्य भवने परमार्चिते॥ तत्राग्निकार्यं कृतवान् कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। अशरूमानेन हुतस्तेनातुष्यद्भुताशनः॥
questions.en: He saw a fire there in the house of the Naga, named Kaurava and the son of Kunti, Dhananjaya, performed his sacrificial rites with devotion before that fire. Agni was much pleased to see the fearlessness with which he poured the libations.
questions.relevance_justification: 26063: Arjuna poured libations before the fire; Agni was pleased by his fearlessness.

questions.question: When Agni asked Arjuna for help burning the Khandava forest, what problem did Arjuna say he had with his bow?
questions.sn: धनुर्मे नास्ति भगवन् बाहुवीर्येण सम्मितम्। कुर्वतः समरे यत्नं वेगं यद् विषहेन्मम॥
questions.en: But, O illustrious one, I have no bow suited to the strength of my arms and capable of bearing the might I put fourth in battle.
questions.relevance_justification: 26393: he has no bow suited to the strength of his arms and able to bear the force he puts forth in battle.

questions.question: When people followed Yudhishthira into exile out of grief, what did he tell them to do?
questions.sn: निवर्ततागता दूरं समागमनशापिताः। स्वजने न्यासभूते मे कार्या स्नेहान्विता मतिः॥
questions.en: Grieved at my departure, you have come far away. Go back. heart be affectionately directed towards the relatives whom we leave behind as our pledges to you.
questions.relevance_justification: 29058: go back; let their affection be directed to the relatives left behind as pledges.
questions.flag_notes: Source English is broken ('Go back. heart be...'). Same forest-departure cluster as the farewell question (row 28889).

questions.question: Where did Krishna say he found Shalva standing with the Saubha car?
questions.sn: ततः सागरमासाद्य कुक्षौ तस्य महोर्मिणः। समुद्रनाभ्यां शाल्वोऽभूत् सौभमास्थाय शत्रुहन्॥
questions.en: O slayer of foes, having reached the ocean (I saw) Shalva on his (Saubha, car made of precious metal in the midst of the ocean full of heaving billows.
questions.relevance_justification: 29690: in the midst of the ocean, on the Saubha car among heaving billows.
questions.flag_notes: Same Saubha episode as Krishna cutting off heads (row 29736).

questions.question: When Bhima urged action in the forest, what did Yudhishthira say about controlling the mind and about what had already happened?
questions.sn: यन्तुं नात्मा शक्यते पौरुषेण मानेन वीर्येण च तात नद्धः। न ते वाचो भीमसेनाभ्यसूये मन्ये तथा तद् भवितव्यमासीत्॥
questions.en: O child, the mind cannot be controlled when it is influenced by manliness, pride and prowess. O Bhimasena, I do not reproach you for what you have said. I consider that what have happened was preordained.
questions.relevance_justification: 30196: the mind cannot be controlled when bound by manliness, pride, and prowess; what happened was preordained.

questions.question: After Pushkara cheated Nala at dice, where did Nala go to live, and who went with him?
questions.sn: स निकृत्या जितो राजा पुष्करेणेति नः श्रुतम्। वनवासं सुदुःखार्तो भार्यया न्यवसत् सह॥
questions.en: We have heard that the king was deceitfully defeated by Pushkara; and in consequence defeated by Pushkara; and in consequence thereof he dwelt in the forest with his spouse, pressed with distress.
questions.relevance_justification: 30788: he dwelt in the forest with his wife, pressed by distress.
questions.flag_notes: Nala cluster with the later dice-or-duel question (row 31560). Different moments.

questions.question: At the opening of the Mahabharata, what did Dhritarashtra tell Sanjaya about his own attitude toward war and the destruction of his race?
questions.sn: श्रुतवानसि मेधावी बुद्धिमान्प्राज्ञसंमतः। न विग्रहे मम मतिर्न च प्रीये कुलक्षये॥
questions.en: You are learned in the Shastras, you are intelligent and you are possessed of wisdom. (Hear), my inclinations were never for war, nor did I feel pleasure in the destruction of my race.
questions.relevance_justification: 19485: he says his mind was never for war and he took no pleasure in the destruction of his family.
questions.flag_notes: Anukramanika framing speech rather than an in-story event verse. Review suitability.

questions.question: When the ocean rose around them, which island did the snakes reach together with their mother?
questions.sn: तदा भूरभवच्छन्ना जलोर्मिभिरनेकशः। रामणीयकमागच्छन्मात्रा सह भुजंगमाः॥
questions.en: When there became countless watery waves, the snakes with their mother reached the island called Ramaniyaka.
questions.relevance_justification: 20536 names the island Ramaniyaka.

questions.question: Who served as the Hota priest at Janamejaya's snake sacrifice, and from which lineage did he come?
questions.sn: तत्र होता बभूवाथ ब्राह्मणश्चण्डभार्गवः। च्यवनस्यान्वये ख्यातो जातो वेदविदां वरः॥
questions.en: The Brahmana, named Chanda Bhargava, born in the race of Chyavana, greatly illustrious and the foremost man amongst all the learned in the Vedas, became the Hota in that sacrifice.
questions.relevance_justification: 21207: Chanda Bhargava, born in the race of Chyavana, was the Hota.
